what: CRITICAL: aide-memory init must also configure the MCP server so aide_recall/aide_remember tools are available in Claude Code sessions. Currently init installs hooks that block and tell the agent to call aide_recall, but the MCP server isn't configured — so the agent can't call aide_recall and gets stuck in a blocking loop. Init needs to add the MCP server config to .claude/settings.json alongside the hooks.
why: Validation showed hooks blocking correctly (4 memories for src/auth/) but agent said "aide_recall MCP tool isn't available in this session" — hooks worked but MCP server wasn't configured. Agent got stuck in infinite block loop then bypassed with bash cat.
